title: catharanthus trichophyllus
intro: Catharanthus trichophyllus, commonly known as the delicate periwinkle or small periwinkle, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its antitumor, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Catharanthus trichophyllus include its ability to inhibit the growth of cancer cells, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as vincristine and vinblastine, which have been isolated and used in the treatment of certain types of cancer.
